record.bible_text: A good name<WH08034> <FI>is<Fi> better<WH02896> than precious<WH02896> ointment<WH08081>; and the day<WH03117> of death<WH04194> than the day<WH03117> of one's birth<WH03205><WTH8736>.

<FI> It is<Fi> better<WH02896> to hear<WH08085><WTH8800> the rebuke<WH01606> of the wise<WH02450>, than for a man<WH0376> to hear<WH08085><WTH8802> the song<WH07892> of fools<WH03684>.

For as the crackling<WH06963> of thorns<WH05518> under a pot<WH05518>, so <FI>is<Fi> the laughter<WH07814> of the fool<WH03684>: this also <FI>is<Fi> vanity<WH01892>. <RF>crackling: Heb. sound<Rf><CM>
Surely oppression<WH06233> maketh a wise man<WH02450> mad<WH01984><WTH8779>; and a gift<WH04979> destroyeth<WH06><WTH8762> the heart<WH03820>.

Better<WH02896> <FI>is<Fi> the end<WH0319> of a thing<WH01697> than the beginning<WH07225> thereof: <FI>and<Fi> the patient<WH0750> in spirit<WH07307> <FI>is<Fi> better<WH02896> than the proud<WH01362> in spirit<WH07307>.
Be not hasty<WH0926><WTH8762> in thy spirit<WH07307> to be angry<WH03707><WTH8800>: for anger<WH03708> resteth<WH05117><WTH8799> in the bosom<WH02436> of fools<WH03684>.

Say<WH0559><WTH8799> not thou, What is <FI>the cause<Fi> that the former<WH07223> days<WH03117> were better<WH02896> than these? for thou dost not enquire<WH07592><WTH8804> wisely<WH02451> concerning this. <RF>wisely: Heb. out of wisdom<Rf><CM>

Wisdom<WH02451> <FI>is<Fi> good<WH02896> with an inheritance<WH05159>: and <FI>by it there is<Fi> profit<WH03148> to them that see<WH07200><WTH8802> the sun<WH08121>. <RF>good...: or, as good as an inheritance, yea, better too<Rf>

For wisdom<WH02451> <FI>is<Fi> a defence<WH06738>, <FI>and<Fi> money<WH03701> <FI>is<Fi> a defence<WH06738>: but the excellency<WH03504> of knowledge<WH01847> <FI>is, that<Fi> wisdom<WH02451> giveth life<WH02421><WTH8762> to them that have<WH01167> it. <RF>defence: Heb. shadow<Rf>
Consider<WH07200><WTH8798> the work<WH04639> of God<WH0430>: for who can<WH03201><WTH8799> make <FI>that<Fi> straight<WH08626><WTH8763>, which he hath made crooked<WH05791><WTH8765>?

In the day<WH03117> of prosperity<WH02896> be joyful<WH02896>, but in the day<WH03117> of adversity<WH07451> consider<WH07200><WTH8798>: God<WH0430> also hath set<WH06213><WTH8804> the one over against<WH05980> the other, to the end<WH01700> that man<WH0120> should find<WH04672><WTH8799> nothing<WH03972> after<WH0310> him. <RF>set: Heb. made<Rf>

All <FI>things<Fi> have I seen<WH07200><WTH8804> in the days<WH03117> of my vanity<WH01892>: there is<WH03426> a just<WH06662> <FI>man<Fi> that perisheth<WH06><WTH8802> in his righteousness<WH06664>, and there is a wicked<WH07563> <FI>man<Fi> that prolongeth<WH0748><WTH8688> <FI>his life<Fi> in his wickedness<WH07451>.

Be not righteous<WH06662> over much<WH07235><WTH8687>; neither make thyself over<WH03148> wise<WH02449><WTH8691>: why shouldest thou destroy<WH08074><WTH8709> thyself? <RF>destroy...: Heb. be desolate?<Rf>

<FI> It is<Fi> good<WH02896> that thou shouldest take hold<WH0270><WTH8799> of this; yea, also from this<WH02088> withdraw<WH03240><WTH8686> not thine hand<WH03027>: for he that feareth<WH03373> God<WH0430> shall come forth<WH03318><WTH8799> of them all.
Wisdom<WH02451> strengtheneth<WH05810><WTH8799> the wise<WH02450> more than ten<WH06235> mighty<WH07989> <FI>men<Fi> which are in the city<WH05892>.
For <FI>there is<Fi> not a just<WH06662> man<WH0120> upon earth<WH0776>, that doeth<WH06213><WTH8799> good<WH02896>, and sinneth<WH02398><WTH8799> not.

Also take<WH05414><WTH8799> no heed<WH03820> unto all words<WH01697> that are spoken<WH01696><WTH8762>; lest thou hear<WH08085><WTH8799> thy servant<WH05650> curse<WH07043><WTH8764> thee: <RF>take...: Heb. give not thine heart<Rf>
For oftentimes<WH06471><WH07227> also thine own heart<WH03820> knoweth<WH03045><WTH8804> that thou thyself likewise hast cursed<WH07043><WTH8765> others<WH0312>.<CM>
All this<WH02090> have I proved<WH05254><WTH8765> by wisdom<WH02451>: I said<WH0559><WTH8804>, I will be wise<WH02449><WTH8799>; but it <FI>was<Fi> far<WH07350> from me.

I applied<WH05437><WTH8804> mine heart<WH03820> to know<WH03045><WTH8800>, and to search<WH08446><WTH8800>, and to seek out<WH01245><WTH8763> wisdom<WH02451>, and the reason<WH02808> <FI>of things<Fi> , and to know<WH03045><WTH8800> the wickedness<WH07562> of folly<WH03689>, even of foolishness<WH05531> <FI>and<Fi> madness<WH01947>: <RF>I applied...: Heb. I and mine heart compassed<Rf>

And I find<WH04672><WTH8802> more bitter<WH04751> than death<WH04194> the woman<WH0802>, whose heart<WH03820> <FI>is<Fi> snares<WH04685> and nets<WH02764>, <FI>and<Fi> her hands<WH03027> <FI>as<Fi> bands<WH0612>: whoso pleaseth<WH02896><WH06440> God<WH0430> shall escape<WH04422><WTH8735> from her; but the sinner<WH02398><WTH8802> shall be taken<WH03920><WTH8735> by her. <RF>whoso...: Heb. he that is good before God<Rf>

Behold<WH07200><WTH8798>, this have I found<WH04672><WTH8804>, saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the preacher<WH06953>, <FI>counting<Fi> one<WH0259> by one<WH0259>, to find out<WH04672><WTH8800> the account<WH02808>: <RF>counting...: or, weighing one thing after another, to find out the reason<Rf>

Which yet my soul<WH05315> seeketh<WH01245><WTH8765>, but I find<WH04672><WTH8804> not: one<WH0259> man<WH0120> among a thousand<WH0505> have I found<WH04672><WTH8804>; but a woman<WH0802> among all those have I not found<WH04672><WTH8804>.
